template: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one 4:3 painted reading-game choice thumbnail. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and composition reference. Input image 2 is the exact NEW CHARACTER identity reference. Replace ONLY the green moss character in image 1 with {CHARACTER} from image 2, preserving the new character’s distinctive face, colors, body material, ears/headwear, scarf/clothes and proportions. Do not blend the two character identities. Adapt the new character’s arms, gaze and stance to perform the SAME learning action. {SCENE} Preserve the original simple layout, all non-character props, correct letters, pale warm cream background, broad gouache texture, dark green outline, friendly lighting, safe margins and landscape 4:3 framing. One full character only, all limbs and props inside the frame. No added captions, words, UI, border or watermark. This must look like another member of exactly the same thumbnail family.

scenes.lydfangst: The character listens with one paw/hand by its ear while pointing toward the S tile. Keep the three cream tiles marked exactly S, A, M and the turquoise sound waves.
scenes.bokstavropet: The character sees a large card marked S and chooses between two carved wooden listening shells. Keep the S card and both shells, with sound waves near one shell.
scenes.ordbyggjar: The character is assembling three interlocking cream tiles spelling exactly lowercase s o l. Keep that simple building action and the letter order.
scenes.forstelyd: The character points to a cream tile marked S next to a friendly sun. Keep the sun, the S tile and the short trail of stepping pebbles.
scenes.lesestigen: The character travels across small mossy stepping stones toward a large open book, holding a small blank reading card. Keep the blank book and all environmental elements.

assembly: Byt {CHARACTER} med figurnamnet i store bokstavar og {SCENE} med teksten for modusen. Fyrste referanse: originalt Mose-spelbilete. Andre referanse: original PNG for figuren.
